response.description: Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor are now generally available. Advanced platform metrics provide finer-grained signals that help customers more quickly and accurately identify changes and trends within their resources.With this release, customers can enable advanced platform metrics directly from the Azure portal, with an in-product banner prompting enablement for subscriptions where the feature is not yet enabled. Advanced platform metrics are also now available in Fairfax and Mooncake, expanding availability beyond the public cloud.
response.title: Generally Available: Advanced platform metrics for Azure Monitor
